ABOUT THE COMPANY

Building companies with lasting value

MIRA CORP is a holding platform that creates, develops and scales businesses with long-term potential. We combine strategic thinking, operational expertise and patient capital to identify promising categories, build distinctive brands and create the systems that support sustainable growth from the first idea to expansion.

MIRA is an owner brand: it creates an environment, builds expertise and manages the portfolio without diluting the individuality of product brands.

House of Brands

MIRA acts as an owner brand: it creates an environment, builds expertise and manages the portfolio while preserving the individuality of each product brand.
